description: Clip PLACEMENT document-invariant contract (accept/reject parity): within one track, clips must be sorted by timelineStartUs and must never overlap (clip[i].start + clip[i].duration <= clip[i+1].start); gaps are legal. Consumed by packages/timeline-schema/tests/invariants.test.ts (zod validateTimelineDoc) and backend/tests/VideoEdit.UnitTests/ClipPlacementParityTests.cs (ExportCompiler.Validate). Every start and every edge (start + duration) sits on the 30fps project frame grid and every clip satisfies the duration formula by construction (rate 1, sourceIn 0, sourceOut = duration), so ONLY the ordering/overlap rule separates valid from invalid. This closes the 'klip yerlesimi' family of the document-invariant parity gap recorded in docs/backlog.md (14. tur, M3 sinifi).
